reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 8 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Pacers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Rockets (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Rockets win 69 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
